name: 燃地灼烧·回合结算
description: 每个回合结束时，所有站在燃烧格上的角色失去当前生命值50%的真实伤害。
skillCode: var shishio = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.templateId === 'red-shishio' && p.ownerPlayerId === context.playerId && p.currentHp > 0; }); if (!shishio) return { success: false, message: '' }; var exts = battle.extensions; var burnTiles = exts && exts.shishioBurnTiles; if (!burnTiles || burnTiles.length === 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var msgs = []; var alivePieces = battle.pieces.filter(function(p) { return p.currentHp > 0; }); alivePieces.forEach(function(p) { var onTile = burnTiles.some(function(t) { return t.x === p.x && t.y === p.y; }); if (!onTile) return; var dmg = Math.ceil(p.currentHp * 0.5); dealDamage(shishio, p, dmg, 'true', battle, 'shishio-burn-endturn'); msgs.push(p.name + ' 被燃地炙烤，失去 ' + dmg + ' 点真实伤害（当前生命值50%）'); }); if (msgs.length === 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; return { success: true, message: msgs.join('；') };
